rationale: Mocha.prototype.parallelMode stores the required ParallelBufferedRunner class on this._runnerClass and Mocha.prototype.run instantiates it via new this._runnerClass(...); the unit tests also construct it after obtaining the class through rewiremock.proxy(() => require(...)). The dynamic-require-constructor rule's described intent (class identity flowing through a require stored on a property, e.g. this._reporter = require(...), then instantiated via new R(...)) covers this shape. fp-novel is defensible because the require here is a static literal path rather than runtime string-keyed module resolution.
prior_verdicts_assessment: Both priors correctly found the real caller at lib/mocha.cjs:993. The regression verdict named the wrong rule (the reporter rule is specific to builtinReporters[name] string-keyed lookup); the fp-novel verdict is defensible but overlooks dynamic-require-constructor.
